_comment: The point of the whole slag chain (#236): vitrify it and quench it, and what freezes out is a
black silicate glass. That is not a metaphor - plasma-vitrified waste slag is amorphous, breaks
with a conchoidal fracture, and is about the closest thing to obsidian anyone manufactures.
recompile:vitrifying, and the type IS the gate. material_economy.md has said since the gem tier
that obsidian is 'made only (melt slag/glass; portal gate is earned)'. minecraft:smelting would
hand this to a vanilla furnace and minecraft:blasting to a vanilla blast furnace - which IS
craftable in this world, because iron is reachable through the Cupola. Measured, not assumed.
ONE slag per block, because a cooking recipe consumes exactly one item - vanilla's ingredient has
no count and this type borrows its shape wholesale. An earlier draft of this comment said four,
as did the guidebook and the design log, and none of the three had been run. The cost lands in
the same place regardless: the Cupola rakes one slag every eight smelts, so a block is eight
remelts plus a twenty-second burn. The dial that IS available here is cookingtime, and 400 is
Final numbers belong to the balance pass (#36).
